integrity: Symbolic all-size proof plus independently implemented finite checks of sampled Munn trees and all small abstract tree shapes; limits explicitly distinguished.
scientific_limitations: Sharp fixed-edge maximum is proved for exactly two free generators with the standard signed alphabet. The arbitrary-rank statement is a multiplicity formula, not an extremal bound. Historical priority could depend on an uninspected general shortest tree-tour enumeration theorem; no independent validation has occurred.
title: Sharp extremal geodesic multiplicities in the two-generated free inverse monoid
